imtihonlar.qiymat: SAT yoki ACT majburiy; TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo SAT/ACT o'rnini bosmaydi
imtihonlar.manba_iborasi: Harvard requires the SAT or ACT to meet its standardized testing requirement.

tolovdan_ozod_qilish.qiymat: Ha: to'lov oilaga og'ir bo'lsa va moliyaviy yordamga topshirilsa, ariza to'lovi bekor qilinadi
tolovdan_ozod_qilish.manba_iborasi: If the admissions application fee presents a hardship for you or your family and you plan on applying for financial aid, the fee will be waived.

xalqaro_yordam_turi.qiymat: Ehtiyojga asoslangan (need-based); xalqaro talabalar amerikaliklar bilan bir xil yordamga ega
xalqaro_yordam_turi.manba_iborasi: International students are eligible for exactly the same aid as American students.

deadline.manba_iborasi: Regular Decision candidates apply by January 1
